text:
elaine: Quick standup: final checklist for launch posts — keywords, JSON-LD schema for webinar + benchmark pages, internal-link matrix, and redirects for legacy blog slugs. Lock edits by EOD Wed.
marco: I'll produce a compact KW set focused on features, benchmarks, and integration queries. also an anchor CSV.
jamal: Drafting two schema blocks (Event + Article). Example Event snippet to put in <head>: ```json {\"@context\":\"https://schema.org\",\"@type\":\"Event\",\"name\":\"Redwood Inference: Launch Webinar\",\"startDate\":\"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z\",\"location\":{\"@type\":\"VirtualLocation\",\"url\":\"https://redwood.ai/webinar\"}} ```
sophia: I exported pre-2024 /blog/* slugs to the Redirects sheet and proposed 302->301 flow after 14 days. shared link in the drive.
elaine: @sophia add an "anchor_rewrite" column with CTA mappings (webinar signup / demo).
sophia: added. examples: \"see benchmark results\" -> /benchmark, \"request a demo\" -> /demo-request.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts => 7 images missing alt text, 2 internal links 404.
marco: will patch alts and fix anchors. internal-link plan: seed (launch overview) -> 5 clusters (benchmark, integration, pricing, migration, case study). limit 2 contextual links per cluster.
elaine: output CSV columns: source_url, target_url, anchor_text, reason and drop in the shared folder.
marco: ETA 15:00 PST :thumbsup:
jamal: When schema is added please validate with Rich Results Test; I'll run smoke validation.
sophia: infra rule samples in sheet comments (nginx rewrite examples) and I'll request low-traffic rollout window 02:00-04:00 UTC.
elaine: final: one primary CTA on top-of-funnel posts = webinar signup. iterate post-launch based on benchmark traffic. :rocket:
